Alif Laam Raa. Yeh Kitaab-e-Khuda aur Quran-e-Mubeen ki aayaat hain
Ek din aane waala hai jab kuffaar bhi yeh tamanna karenge ke kaash hum bhi musalmaan hote
Inhein un ke haal par chhod do, khaayein piyein aur maze udaayein, aur umeedein inhein ghaflat mein daale rahein, anqareeb inhein sab kuch maaloom ho jaaega
Aur hum ne kisi qarya ko halaak nahin kiya magar yeh ke us ke liye ek mee'aad muqarrar kar di thi
Koi ummat na apne waqt se aage badh sakti hai aur na peechhe hat sakti hai
Aur un logon ne kaha ke aye woh shakhs jis par Quran naazil hua hai! Tu deewaana hai
Agar tu apne da'we mein sachcha hai to farishton ko kyon saamne nahin laata hai
Haalaanke hum farishton ko haq ke faisle ke saath hi bheja karte hain, aur us ke baad phir kisi ko mohlat nahin di jaati hai
Hum ne hi is Quran ko naazil kiya hai aur hum hi is ki hifaazat karne waale hain
Aur hum ne aap se pehle bhi mukhtalif qaumon mein rasool bheje hain
Aur jab un ke paas rasool aate hain to yeh sirf un ka mazaaq udaate hain
Aur hum isi tarah is gumraahi ko mujrimeen ke dil mein daal dete hain
Yeh kabhi imaan na laayenge, ke un se pehle waalon ka tareeqa bhi aisa hi reh chuka hai
Hum agar aasmaan mein un ke liye koi darwaaza khol dein aur yeh log din dahaade usi darwaaze se chadh jaayein
To bhi kahenge ke hamaari aankhon ko madhosh kar diya gaya hai aur hum par jaadoo kar diya gaya hai
Aur hum ne aasmaan mein burj banaaye aur unhein dekhne waalon ke liye sitaaron se aaraasta kar diya
Aur har Shaitaan-e-Rajeem se mahfooz bana diya
Magar yeh ke koi Shaitaan wahaan ki baat chura lena chaahe to us ke peechhe dahakta hua sho'la laga diya gaya hai
Aur hum ne zameen ko phaila diya hai aur us mein pahaadon ke langar daal diye hain, aur har cheez ko mu'ayyana miqdaar ke mutaabiq paida kiya hai
Aur us mein tumhaare liye bhi asbaab-e-ma'eeshat qaraar diye hain aur un ke liye bhi jin ke tum raaziq nahin ho
Aur koi shai aisi nahin hai jis ke hamaare paas khazaane na hon, aur hum har shai ko ek mu'ayyan miqdaar mein hi naazil karte hain
Aur hum ne hawaaon ko baadalon ka bojh uthaane waala bana kar chalaaya hai, phir aasmaan se paani barsaaya hai jis se tum ko seeraab kiya hai, aur tum us ke khazaana-daar nahin the
Aur hum hi hayaat o maut ke dene waale hain, aur hum hi sab ke waali o waaris hain
Aur hum tum se pehle guzar jaane waalon ko bhi jaante hain aur baad mein aane waalon se bhi baakhabar hain
Aur tumhaara Parwardigar hi sab ko ek jagah jama karega, ke woh saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi
Aur hum ne insaan ko siyaahi-maail narm mitti se paida kiya hai jo sookh kar khan khan bolne lagi thi
Aur jinnaat ko is se pehle zehreeli aag se paida kiya hai
Aur us waqt ko yaad karo ke jab tumhaare Parwardigar ne malaaika se kaha tha ke main siyaahi-maail narm khankhanaati hui mitti se ek bashar paida karne waala hoon
Phir jab mukammal kar loon aur us mein apni rooh-e-hayaat phoonk doon to sab ke sab sajde mein gir padna
To tamaam malaaika ne ijtimaai taur par sajda kar liya tha
Ilaawa Iblees ke, ke woh sajda-guzaaron ke saath na ho saka
Allah ne kaha ke aye Iblees! Tujhe kya ho gaya hai ke tu sajda-guzaaron mein shaamil na ho saka
Us ne kaha ke main aise bashar ko sajda nahin kar sakta jise tu ne siyaahi-maail khushk mitti se paida kiya hai
Irshaad hua ke tu yahaan se nikal ja ke tu mardood hai
Aur tujh par qiyaamat ke din tak la'nat hai
Us ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Mujhe roz-e-hashr tak ki mohlat de de
Jawaab mila ke tujhe mohlat de di gayi hai
Ek maaloom aur mu'ayyan waqt ke liye
Us ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Jis tarah tu ne mujhe gumraah kiya hai main un bandon ke liye zameen mein saaz o saamaan aaraasta karoonga aur sab ko ikattha gumraah karoonga
Ilaawa tere un bandon ke jinhein tu ne khaalis bana liya hai
Irshaad hua ke yahi mera seedha raasta hai
Mere bandon par tera koi ikhtiyaar nahin hai, ilaawa un ke jo gumraahon mein se teri pairwi karne lagein
Aur Jahannam aise tamaam logon ki aakhri waada-gaah hai
Us ke saat darwaaze hain, aur har darwaaze ke liye ek hissa taqseem kar diya gaya hai
Beshak saahibaan-e-taqwa baaghaat aur chashmon ke darmiyaan rahenge
Inhein hukm hoga ke tum in baaghaat mein salaamati aur hifaazat ke saath daakhil ho jaao
Aur hum ne un ke seenon se har tarah ki kudoorat nikaal li hai, aur woh bhaiyon ki tarah aamne saamne takht par baithe honge
Na inhein koi takleef chhoo sakegi aur na wahaan se nikaale jaayenge
Mere bandon ko khabar kar do ke main bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hoon
Aur mera azaab bhi bada dardnaak azaab hai
Aur inhein Ibraheem ke mehmaanon ke baare mein ittilaa de do
Jab woh log Ibraheem ke paas waarid hue aur salaam kiya to unhon ne kaha ke hum aap se khaufzada hain
Unhon ne kaha ke aap darein nahin, hum aap ko ek farzand-e-daana ki bashaarat dene ke liye aaye hain
Ibraheem ne kaha ke ab jab ke budhaapa chha gaya hai to mujhe kis cheez ki bashaarat de rahe ho
Unhon ne kaha ke hum aap ko bilkul sachchi bashaarat de rahe hain, khabardaar aap maayooson mein se na ho jaayein
Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke rehmat-e-Khuda se siwaaye gumraahon ke kaun maayoos ho sakta hai
Phir kaha ke magar yeh to bataaiye ke aap logon ka maqsad kya hai
Unhon ne kaha ke hum ek mujrim qaum ki taraf bheje gaye hain
Ilaawa Loot ke ghar waalon ke, ke un mein ke har ek ko najaat dene waale hain
Ilaawa un ki biwi ke, ke us ke liye hum ne tai kar diya hai ke woh azaab mein reh jaane waalon mein se hogi
Phir jab farishte Aal-e-Loot ke paas aaye
Aur Loot ne kaha ke tum to ajnabi qism ke log maaloom hote ho
To unhon ne kaha hum woh azaab le kar aaye hain jis mein aap ki qaum shak kiya karti thi
Ab hum woh barhaq azaab le kar aaye hain aur hum bilkul sachche hain

Aap raat gaye apne ahl ko le kar nikal jaayein aur khud peechhe peechhe sab ki nigraani karte chalein, aur koi peechhe ki taraf mud kar bhi na dekhe, aur jidhar ka hukm diya gaya hai sab udhar hi chale jaayein
Aur hum ne is amr ka faisla kar liya hai ke subah hote hote is qaum ki jadein tak kaat di jaayengi
Aur idhar shehar waale naye mehmaanon ko dekh kar khushiyaan manaate hue aa gaye
Loot ne kaha ke yeh hamaare mehmaan hain, khabardaar humein badnaam na karna
Aur Allah se daro aur ruswaai ka saamaan na karo
Un logon ne kaha ke kya hum ne aap ko sab ke aane se mana nahin kar diya tha
Loot ne kaha ke yeh hamaari qaum ki ladkiyaan haazir hain agar tum aisa hi karna chaahte ho
Aap ki jaan ki qasam! Yeh log gumraahi ke nashe mein andhe ho rahe hain
Nateeja yeh hua ke subah hote hi inhein ek cheekh ne apni giraft mein le liya
Phir hum ne inhein teh o baala kar diya aur un ke oopar kharanje aur pattharon ki baarish kar di
In baaton mein saahibaan-e-hosh ke liye badi nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aur yeh basti ek mustaqil chalne waale raaste par hai
Aur beshak is mein bhi saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye nishaaniyaan hain
Aur beshak Aika waale zaalim the
To hum ne un se bhi intiqaam liya, aur yeh dono bastiyaan waazeh shaah-raah par hain
Aur Ashaab-ul-Hijr ne bhi mursaleen ki takzeeb ki
Aur hum ne inhein bhi apni nishaaniyaan deen to woh e'raaz karne waale hi reh gaye
Aur yeh log pahaad ko taraash kar mahfooz qism ke makaanaat banaate the
To inhein bhi subah-savere hi ek chinghaad ne pakad liya
To unhon ne jis qadar bhi haasil kiya tha kuch kaam na aaya
Aur hum ne aasmaan o zameen aur un ke darmiyaan jo kuch bhi hai sab ko barhaq paida kiya hai, aur qiyaamat bahar-haal aane waali hai, lihaaza aap un se khoobsoorati ke saath darguzar kar dein
Beshak aap ka Parwardigar sab ka paida karne waala aur sab ka jaanne waala hai
Aur hum ne aap ko Sab'-e-Masaani aur Quran-e-Azeem ata kiya hai

Lihaaza aap in kuffaar mein ba'z afraad ko hum ne jo kuch ne'mat-e-duniya ata kar di hai us ki taraf nigaah utha kar bhi na dekhein, aur us ke baare mein hargiz ranjeeda bhi na hon. Bas aap apne shaanon ko saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye jhukaaye rakhein
Aur yeh keh dein ke main to bahut waazeh andaaz se daraane waala hoon
Jis tarah ke hum ne un logon par azaab naazil kiya hai jo Kitaab-e-Khuda ka hissa-baant karne waale the
Jin logon ne Quran ko tukde kar diya hai
Lihaaza aap ke Parwardigar ki qasam! Ke hum un se is baare mein zaroor sawaal karenge
Jo kuch woh kiya karte the
Pas aap us baat ka waazeh e'laan kar dein jis ka hukm diya gaya hai aur mushrikeen se kinaara-kash ho jaayein
Hum un istehza karne waalon ke liye kaafi hain
Jo Khuda ke saath doosra khuda qaraar dete hain, aur anqareeb inhein un ka haal maaloom ho jaaega
Aur hum jaante hain ke aap un ki baaton se dil-tang ho rahe hain
To ab apne Parwardigar ki hamd ki tasbeeh kijiye aur sajda-guzaaron mein shaamil ho jaaiye
Aur us waqt tak apne Rab ki ibaadat karte rahiye jab tak ke maut na aa jaaye
